PEAK IS BACK!!!!

It picks up exactly where the first season ended, with the long-awaited date. Chinatsu seems really into Taiki and determined about her feelings. When she came rushing to the train platform to catch up with Taiki, leaving that “lovely” senpai Kazuma behind, I got chills.

On the observation deck, Taiki came incredibly close to confessing his feelings, but as usually happens in these situations, he got interrupted. And the one who interrupted him was the true villain of this arc: the empathetic and absolutely lovely Yumeka, who managed to earn the award for Most Annoying Character in the series with just three lines.

P.S. I noticed that Hina doesn’t appear at all, not even in the opening. This worries me.

Hina does appear in the ending theme (even if briefly), so there’s that, at least.
